elsewhere:lore_royal_proclamation: A 12-page written book in the voice of King Osric Vael, the Hundredth Crown. It tells of the five Lords, the Seals, the villages and the Survey.

How to get: a royal patrol's Sergeant (the courier) hands you one if you right-click him while he is not fighting you; it is also in the courier's pouch if he dies, in the Reeve's stall (3 emeralds) and rarely in castle dungeons.
elsewhere:lore_survey_fragment: A torn corner of the royal surveyors' chart. Three of them craft one folded Royal Survey Map.
How to get: Captains drop one 25% of the time, patrol couriers 40%, other patrol soldiers 4%. Also found in Aldermark outpost, armory and dungeon chests, and 12% of village cartographer chests.
elsewhere:lore_royal_survey_map: Craft 3 Survey Map Fragments (shapeless). Use it in the Overworld to unfold it: it turns into an explorer-style map centred on the nearest Castle Aldermark, with a red X.
If no castle is known within about 4,000 blocks, the map stays folded and tells you so.
A cartographer in a village you liberated also sells the finished map: 12 emeralds and a compass.
elsewhere:aldermark_crown: The coin of the Kingdom of Aldermark. Soldiers carry them: about 1 to 3 per rank-and-file soldier, 4 to 8 per officer, 16 to 32 per Lord and a 64-Crown treasury from the King on his first defeat.
Spend them with the Royal Steward of a liberated town. Prices are deliberately very high, so Crowns are a long-term alternative to a trading hall, not a shortcut.
elsewhere:bodkin_bolt: An arrow that ignores 25% of the target's armor. Good against late-game armored targets, not a damage boost.
How to get: Crossbowmen drop 2 to 6 at 15%. The Royal Steward sells 8 for 32 Crowns (Novice).
elsewhere:whetstone: Restores 15% durability to a sword, axe or tool in your other hand. A consumable, not a Mending replacement.
How to get: Men-at-Arms drop it 5% of the time.
elsewhere:fletchers_bundle: Use it for 8 arrows and 1 spectral arrow.
How to get: Archers drop it 10% of the time.
elsewhere:sergeants_horn: Blow it: allies within 12 blocks get Strength I for 8 seconds. 90 second cooldown.
How to get: Sergeants drop it 20% of the time.
elsewhere:oathkeepers_seal: A weaker totem. Held, it saves you from death once: you stay at 3 hearts with Resistance II for 2 seconds. Single use, shares the 30 second death-protection lockout with other extra lives.
How to get: officers drop it 4% of the time; each Lord drops one on your first kill of him; the Royal Steward sells it for 256 Crowns (Expert, once per in-game week).
elsewhere:aldermark_armor_trim_smithing_: Cosmetic armor trim. Duplicate it like any vanilla template.
How to get: Captains drop it 8% of the time; the Royal Steward sells copies for 24 to 48 Crowns (Novice).
elsewhere:aldermark_banner_pattern: A cosmetic banner pattern: the Aldermark Tower.
How to get: Standard-Bearers always drop one; the Royal Steward sells copies (24 to 48 Crowns, Novice). Quartermasters sell vanilla patterns for Lord Seals.
elsewhere:village_royal_coffer: The iron-bound job site of the Royal Steward, the kingdom's former tax collector, who surrendered when the village was liberated and stayed on.

Serfs build it into the tax office of a fortified town. It cannot be crafted and drops nothing when broken, so a Steward exists only in towns you really liberated: at most one per town. A jobless villager can take the job the vanilla way if the Steward dies.

Royal Steward trades (Crowns): cosmetics 24-48 and Bodkin Bolts x8 for 32 (Novice); Oathkeeper's Seal 256, one per week (Expert); enchanted books Sharpness V, Protection IV, Efficiency V or Unbreaking III, 192 Crowns + 4 emerald blocks each, 2 of the 4 per Steward, restock weekly (Master); Netherite Upgrade Template 320 Crowns + 24 diamonds, one per week (Master). Master needs at least 2 Lords dead.
elsewhere:village_royal_purse: The seized village treasury, handed back after a liberation.
elsewhere:village_ash: Ash left where a siege burned a village. The restore command clears it.
elsewhere:village_charred_planks: Burnt planks from a besieged village. Restoring the village brings the originals back.
elsewhere:village_siege_fire: A controlled siege fire. It burns only village blocks and goes out on its own.
elsewhere:hrafnholt_royal_proclamation: A 10-page written book: High Jarl Halvard Ironbrow's blunt Hearth-Oath. Each page is a few lines in the kingdom's own voice, and it mentions Aldermark's tower-flag.
How to get: the Hird-Sergeant of a Hrafnholt war-band hands you one if you right-click him while he is not fighting you; also in the courier's pouch if he dies.
elsewhere:hrafnholt_survey_fragment: A torn corner of a Hrafnholt chart. Three of them craft one folded Hrafnholt Survey Map.
How to get: Hrafnholt couriers drop one 40% of the time, other patrol soldiers 4%.
elsewhere:hrafnholt_survey_map: Craft 3 Hrafnholt Survey Map Fragments (shapeless). Use it in the Overworld to unfold it: it becomes an explorer-style map centred on Castle Hrafnholt, with a red X.
A cartographer in a village you liberated from Hrafnholt also sells the finished map: 12 emeralds and a compass.

elsewhere:azmar_well_stone: A carved well-marker of the Sultanate. A keepsake and trade good, it does nothing by itself.
How to get: always in the Azmar caravan-master's pouch.
elsewhere:lore_seal_marshal: The seal of Marshal Ysolde Varr, pressed in wax and Glimmer. Quartermasters and the Reeve buy any Seal for 12 emeralds, and swap Marshal and Chancellor Seals plus 6 emeralds for banner patterns.
How to get: dropped by Marshal Ysolde Varr when defeated. Each Seal counts toward the Sovereign's Standard.
